test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question: What will be the consequence of high fertility?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. '**Iow economic growth**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first** sentence of the first paragraph says that "a United Nations report said on Monday, warning that high fertility would challenge economic growth."
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that the consequence of high fertility is Iow economic growth.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 1.
